queue.title: Every Fed Meeting Is Now 'Live,' Pimco's Clarida Says
queue.resumo: Richard Clarida, Pimco global economic adviser and a former Federal Reserve vice chairman, says the Fed is prepared to hike if inflation pressures don't ease. He speaks after Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's speech at the central bank's annual conference in Jackson Hole, Wyoming. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: 'We Got What We Needed From This Speech,' Says Kate Moore
queue.resumo: Citi Wealth CIO Kate Moore joins Bloomberg's Lisa Abramowicz and Tom Keene from Jackson Hole, Wyoming. She reacts to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's debut Jackson Hole speech. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: Fed’s Warsh: Full Speech at Jackson Hole Symposium
queue.resumo: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said inflation isn’t meaningfully slowing and warned that policymakers must be confident that it is, otherwise the central bank has “work to do.” He reiterated that policymakers will return inflation to their 2% goal, which he said is a firm and fixed target. He spoke at the Fed’s annual economic symposium in Jackson Hole, Wyoming. (Source: Bloomberg)
